capabilities: Disable Backspace and Delete keys while writing
Activate Brain Dump Mode from the sidebar train icon
Chase the user with a shark when typing speed drops
disambiguation: Not an editing or formatting tool; it restricts editing entirely during drafting rather than improving it.
intentEvidence: Brain Dump Mode helps you complete your first messy draft without the temptation to edit.
motivation: The author believes 'Done is better than perfect' and built it to force completion of a first draft before polishing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to stop perfectionist self-editing while drafting, which stalls first drafts and brainstorming.
summary: Writing-mode plugin that disables Backspace and Delete so you finish a messy first draft without editing.
